rows.finding: All thirteen complete units read. Direct authored claim, textual headings, regulations, requests, biography, delegated whisk-holding, and Linji’s narrated event are now separated correctly. Named masters who perform the formal address remain contextual rather than being falsely made utterers of editorial headings. The physical ascent and institutional address are one event in the evidence, not two different things.

All seven complete cases read. Two unnamed monks own their questions, named respondents are retained, four direct speakers hold, and Yuanwu is correctly restored as quoted utterer in the Dahui biography. Danger, relinquishment, death, and revival are all explicitly present without interpretive over-resolution.

All seven complete turns read. The four unnamed question/thanks tokens and their actual respondents are correctly separated from Luohan, Tiantai, and Dongchan’s direct commentarial speech. The entry properly describes reply-language without treating the label as certification that an answer is adequate.

All eight complete narratives read. Every token is narrator-owned action report; named performers, recipients, teachers, and later raiser are retained contextually, while the final externalist remains genuinely unnamed rather than guessed. No contextual figure is substituted into MasterName.

All seven complete turns read. Direct named speakers hold; Baizhang Le is correctly identified as a non-roster commentator; the Langting token belongs to the unnamed monk’s compact reply. The shared prior-expectation/recognition grammar is supported and does not invent a special faculty.

All seven complete units read. Every named speaker owns the phrase, including its warning, prohibition, appraisal, and case-comment uses. Those different stances concern the same observable act of proceeding by means of an existing error and do not warrant a sense split.

All seven complete turns read. The first and last questions correctly belong to unnamed monks with Fenyang and Sanzu as respondents; the five middle speakers directly own their uses. Exercise and criticism of the authoritative command remain one referent.

All six complete units read. Dedication heading, code office label, two Nanquan narratives, unnamed ancient-master instruction, and Longya biography are correctly distinguished. Nanquan is a case figure rather than utterer, and Longya is the named office-holder. Office and holder are the same institutional role, not artificial polysemy.

All five complete verse/address units read. Three named speakers own their lines; both 頌曰 verses remain anonymous, with Linquan only a later commentator in the relevant source. The impossible-animation synthesis is fully visible and restrained.
